name: std-panel-launcher
description: std-panel-launcher — a floating button on the page that opens a side panel holding one trait (an assistant, a help panel, a cart). Closed: the button floats bottom-right. Open: the panel shows `contentTrait` under `title` and the button steps aside; the panel's close button (or Escape on small screens) brings the button back. The panel slot defaults to `dock`, which pushes the page aside on wide screens and becomes a side sheet below 1024px. List the trait on every page that should carry the button — it never injects itself.
